import copy
import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from task_batches import plan_batches


def task(task_id, depends_on=(), priority=0):
    return {"id": task_id, "depends_on": list(depends_on), "priority": priority}


class TaskBatchesWorkerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_batching_by_levels(self):
        tasks = [task("a"), task("b", ["a"]), task("c", ["a"]), task("d", ["b", "c"])]
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches(tasks, []), [["a"], ["b", "c"], ["d"]])

    def test_priority_descending_with_input_position_ties(self):
        tasks = [task("x", [], 1), task("y", [], 5), task("z", [], 1), task("w", [], -2)]
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches(tasks, []), [["y", "x", "z", "w"]])

    def test_completed_nodes_omitted_and_satisfy_dependencies(self):
        tasks = [task("a"), task("b", ["a", "ext"]), task("c", ["b"])]
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches(tasks, ["a", "ext", "ext"]), [["b"], ["c"]])
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches([task("a")], ["a"]), [])
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches([], []), [])

    def test_duplicate_dependencies_treated_as_set(self):
        tasks = [task("a"), task("b", ["a", "a"])]
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches(tasks, []), [["a"], ["b"]])

    def test_invalid_shapes(self):
        bad_calls = [
            ((), []),
            ([], ()),
            ([task("a")], [""]),
            ([{"id": "a", "depends_on": []}], []),
            ([{"id": "a", "depends_on": [], "priority": 0, "x": 1}], []),
            ([task("")], []),
            ([task("a", [""])], []),
            ([{"id": "a", "depends_on": ("b",), "priority": 0}], []),
            ([task("a", [], True)], []),
            ([task("a", [], 1.0)], []),
            ([task("a"), task("a"), 5], []),
        ]
        for tasks, completed in bad_calls:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^INVALID_TASK$"):
                plan_batches(tasks, completed)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^DUPLICATE_TASK$"):
            plan_batches([task("a"), task("a", ["missing"])], [])

    def test_missing_dependency_including_completed_tasks(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^MISSING_DEPENDENCY$"):
            plan_batches([task("a", ["missing"])], [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^MISSING_DEPENDENCY$"):
            plan_batches([task("a", ["missing"])], ["a"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^MISSING_DEPENDENCY$"):
            plan_batches([task("a", ["b"]), task("b", ["a"]), task("c", ["gone"])], [])

    def test_cycles_and_long_chain(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^DEPENDENCY_CYCLE$"):
            plan_batches([task("a", ["a"])], [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^DEPENDENCY_CYCLE$"):
            plan_batches([task("ok"), task("a", ["c"]), task("b", ["a"]), task("c", ["b"])], [])
        self.assertEqual(plan_batches([task("a", ["b"]), task("b", ["a"])], ["a"]), [["b"]])
        chain = [task("n0")] + [task(f"n{i}", [f"n{i - 1}"]) for i in range(1, 1200)]
        result = plan_batches(chain, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1200)
        self.assertEqual(result[-1], ["n1199"])

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        tasks = [task("b", ["a", "a"], 2), task("a", [], 1)]
        completed = ["z", "z"]
        tasks_before = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
        completed_before = list(completed)
        plan_batches(tasks, completed)
        self.assertEqual(tasks, tasks_before)
        self.assertEqual(completed, completed_before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
